## LAFC vs LA Galaxy Preview [...] ### LA Galaxy

Greg Vanney could bring right-back Calegari into the back four, and winger Joseph Paintsil is in contention for a recall on the right of a probable 4-2-3-1. Isaiah Parente's ankle injury adds to an absence list that already includes Riqui Puig, Hirving Lozano and Kyogo Furuhashi, which leaves Marco Reus and João Klauss carrying much of the creative and scoring burden.
